data.name: check_service_availability
data.description: List open appointment slots for a service at a Ridgeway store over the next 7 days

prompt: Use when the user wants to book a service visit or test ride and you know the store and service type. Ask which store is closest to them if you don't know. Before calling, say 'One moment while I check the schedule.' Read back at most three slots. Do NOT use to answer general questions about store hours.
